correctness.rationale: For a rooted complete binary tree, the signed independent-set sum pair (F_h,E_h) satisfies E_h=F_{h-1,L}F_{h-1,R}, F_h=E_h+(-1)^r E_{h-1,L}E_{h-1,R}, initialized at height0 by (2,1),(0,1). Mod2 every character has the parity of the unsigned independent-set total; q_h mod2 follows q_{h-1}+q_{h-2}, periodic 0,1,1 at heights 0,1,2, giving lower gaps 2,1,1. Explicit all-descendant-equal state cycle (0,1)->(1,0)->(1,1)->(0,1) produces multiplier1 in the nonzero residues, zero at height multiples of3; switching its final root sign produces 2, proving sharp gap all h. At h=3, complete height2 signed-state ratio table totals 128 and contains 120 occurrences of ratio1 and one each 25/9 and 9/25; zero criterion needs pair product+1 at root sign-1, giving 120²+2=14402 zeros, and no root sign+1 cancellations. Character group size 32768, rank18366, nonzero gap2, unsigned count2306, Parseval sum 75563008. Independent integer state recurrence replicated entire ratio table and nullity. Fourier character diagonalization gives Moore–Penrose inverse norm reciprocal gap.
